statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope
These symptoms are poorly correlated with standard short-term monitoring
There is concern for intermittent bradyarrhythmias associated with sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmia
Diagnosis codes I49.5 and I49.9 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
